decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 8 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 1 caused a collision with Car 81 in turn 1.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 1 attempted to overtake Car 81 on the inside into Turn 1, but never got far enough alongside. Both cars collided shortly after the apex. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 1 was wholly at fault and caused the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
